post.title: $100 in 1928: $1.16M in stocks, $2,578 in T-bills
post.ig:
Since 1928, $100 in US stocks grew past $1 million.

The same $100 in 3-month Treasury bills grew to about $2,578 by the end of 2025 (before inflation) (Damodaran, NYU Stern).
The price of that growth: the S&P 500 fell in 26 of 98 years, lost 43.8% in 1931 and 18.1% in 2022.
Stocks compounded about 10% a year; T-bills about 3.4%.

Sources: Aswath Damodaran, NYU Stern (1928-2025 data); S&P Dow Jones Indices.
News and education, not financial advice. Past returns don't predict future returns.
